title: Oily Baked Brazilian Red Snapper Wrap
description: A buttery and flavorful Brazilian dish featuring red snapper, wrapped in a pandan leaf, perfect for a midnight craving. This low-calorie friendly recipe is sure to satisfy your hunger.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the red snapper fillets and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together the unsalted butter, lime juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the red snapper fillets.
Wrap each fillet in a pandan leaf, making sure to seal the edges tightly.
Place the wrapped fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the fillets in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
Remove the fillets from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes before serving.
